description: This file defines the 'JsonArray' interface which models an immutable JSON array structure, including methods for creation, modification, querying, and building JSON arrays within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.json' package.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonArray from a string, a single value, an array of values, or an iterable of values, with automatic conversion to appropriate JsonValue types.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Produces a new mutable builder for constructing a JsonArray.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder pre-initialized with the contents of this JsonArray for modifications.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new JsonArray with the specified value(s) appended, supporting various primitive and JsonValue types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific index as an Optional<JsonValue>.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the array contains a specific JsonValue.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence index of a JsonValue in the array.
